scenarios.task: Choose a handoff protocol for a rotating customer-support team that must preserve unresolved-case context while keeping ownership changes auditable.

constraints.text: each ownership change must leave a reviewable audit trail
unresolved customer context must survive a shift boundary
the protocol must fit a small rotating team

alternatives.label: Continuous unstructured team chat
alternatives.reason: a continuous stream can make the current owner and acknowledged follow-up difficult to verify

alternatives.label: Weekly case digest
alternatives.reason: a weekly cadence can delay transfer of cases that cross daily shift boundaries

evidence.text: recently reopened cases often lacked a recorded next action after ownership changed
the support owner changes twice during each operating day

failedAttempt.reason: a high-priority case remained unowned because a chat handoff was never acknowledged

scenarios.task: Choose a review workflow for a maintenance team that combines automated sensor readings with technician notes and must revisit decisions when calibration drift changes.

choice.label: Scheduled evidence review with exception checks

constraints.text: technician observations must remain visible beside automated readings
maintenance decisions must retain the evidence used at review time
field staff may work through intermittent connectivity

alternatives.label: Review only after automated alerts
alternatives.reason: alert thresholds can omit patterns recorded only in technician notes

alternatives.label: Unscheduled technician discretion
alternatives.reason: an unscheduled cadence can make comparable equipment receive different review attention

evidence.text: technician vibration notes preceded two automated threshold alerts during the last quarter
calibration checks currently record drift percentages for each device

failedAttempt.reason: a bearing issue progressed because repeated technician notes were not reviewed before the alert threshold fired
